# MAHALO: Private Lifestyle Protection

> Some choose a lifestyle. Others protect it. MAHALO provides discreet, hospitality-minded private protection for affluent individuals and families, executives, estate owners and luxury hospitality clients. MAHALO is an exclusive private-protection offering of Dumbarton Security Services LLC (Florida Class B Security Agency License B1900383).

Contact: 727-400-6259 · info@mahalosecurity.com · https://www.mahalosecurity.com/

## Services

- [The Private Estate](https://www.mahalosecurity.com/estate-protection.html): Private estate, residential and family protection. Discreet estate security, luxury residential protection and family protection from MAHALO, designed around your home, your household and the way you live.
- [The Executive Life](https://www.mahalosecurity.com/executive-protection.html): Executive protection and personal security. Executive protection and personal security for chief executives, principals and their families: discreet, polished and designed around a demanding schedule.
- [The World of Hospitality](https://www.mahalosecurity.com/luxury-hospitality-security.html): Luxury hotels, resorts, private clubs and residential communities. Hospitality-minded protection for luxury hotels, resorts, private clubs and residential communities, safeguarding distinguished guests, members and residents.
- [The Private Journey](https://www.mahalosecurity.com/yacht-aviation-travel-security.html): Yacht, maritime, private aviation and travel security coordination. Yacht and maritime protection, private aviation and luxury travel security coordination, so every journey at sea or in the air feels effortless.
- [The Art of Entertaining](https://www.mahalosecurity.com/private-event-security.html): Private events, VIP protection and exclusive gatherings. Discreet private event security and VIP protection for celebrations, galas, private dinners and exclusive gatherings, so hosts and guests simply enjoy.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What is private lifestyle protection?** Private lifestyle protection is personal security designed around the way you live: your home, your family, your work, your travel and your occasions. Rather than simply placing guards at a door, MAHALO designs discreet, hospitality-minded protection that lets you live fully, with confidence.
- **Who does MAHALO serve?** MAHALO serves affluent individuals and families, executives, estate owners and luxury hospitality clients, including hotels, resorts, private clubs and residential communities.
- **What services does MAHALO offer?** MAHALO offers five lifestyle services: The Private Estate (private estate, residential and family protection), The Executive Life (executive protection and personal security), The World of Hospitality (luxury hotels, resorts, private clubs and residential communities), The Private Journey (yacht, maritime, private aviation and travel security coordination) and The Art of Entertaining (private events, VIP protection and exclusive gatherings).
- **Is MAHALO licensed?** MAHALO is an exclusive private-protection offering of Dumbarton Security Services LLC, which holds Florida Class B Security Agency License B1900383.
- **How does an engagement begin?** Every engagement begins with a private, confidential conversation. Call 727-400-6259 or email info@mahalosecurity.com, or request a consultation through this website.
